title: GDScript: Add "Quick Fix" to create function stub matching signal connection

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Implements part of https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14307 (but does not close it completely)
  - This PR could be expanded to also create general function stubs, and then perhaps close the issue.

## Additional information

>[!note]
> This PR is dependent on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121338 being merged first. It looks like the branch, and thus the PR itself, include #121338's commits in it so this _could_ technically be merged on its own and it would supersede #121338. But I think it would be better to merge #121338 on its own first, then have these changes reviewed and merged separately.

This PR adds a "Quick Fix" code action, which detects when a non-existent function name is provided to a `Signal.connect()` call, and creates a function stub with the signal's signature below the current function.


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/579e1a28-7b94-4c92-a7cd-fb55924d5550


## To Do

- [x] Confirm signal detection works when the signal belongs to the script class (i.e., defined with `signal some_name(...)` up above in the file)
- [x] Confirm signal detection works when the signal is from the class the script inherits from (i.e., script has `extends SomeOtherClass`)
- [x] Move detection/construction of code actions from `gdscript_analyzer.cpp` into `push_error()`, perhaps by adding a "code action hint" optional parameter to `push_error()`
- [x] Ensure a code action that aims to insert text at the end of the file creates space for it
- [x] Create tests
- [x] Respect type hint settings for created function arguments and return type
